data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. This can sometimes be caused by a temporary issue with our payment gateway or specific card issuer restrictions. Please ensure no VPNs are active and try again after 30 minutes. If the issue persists, try using a different card or contact your bank to ensure there are no blocks on transactions with CloudDesk. You may also try contacting us with the full error message for further investigation. [T-5825] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
